title: AI-guided experiments uncover a new polymer polymorph and improve organic transistor performance
summary: An AI-powered advisor in an autonomous fabrication-and-test platform guided 64 trials of mixed ion–electron conducting polymers for organic electrochemical transistors. The study reports a mobility–volumetric-capacitance figure of merit up to 1,275 F cm⁻¹ V⁻¹ s⁻¹, a 150% improvement over conventional spin coating, identifies larger crystalline lamellar spacing and greater specific surface area as favorable structural factors, and reports a previously unknown polymer polymorph.
ai_technology: Adaptive AI decision interface and AI advisor integrated with autonomous electronic-material fabrication and testing
organization: The University of Chicago; Argonne National Laboratory; Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory; University of Southern Mississippi

evidence.tested: An AI-powered advisor in an autonomous fabrication-and-test platform guided 64 trials of mixed ion–electron conducting polymers for organic electrochemical transistors.
evidence.unknown: The primary source describes a single mixed-ion/electron conducting polymer system and an organic electrochemical transistor testbed. The reported 150% figure-of-merit improvement is relative to conventional spin coating in the study. Structural-factor associations come from a small set of ten statistically selected samples; they are not general causal rules. The new polymorph is reported in the primary paper, but the available abstract does not establish broader stability or device lifetime. The platform includes human-AI interaction and laboratory personnel performed synthesis, fabrication and characterization.
evidence.ai_role: The AI advisor monitored experimental progress in real time, analyzed results and collaborated interactively with researchers to adapt the fabrication, testing and analysis steps across a data-limited campaign. The resulting AI/AE workflow guided experimental exploration over 64 autonomous trials; the model did not merely predict properties from a benchmark dataset. Human researchers synthesized polymers, fabricated devices and performed electrical and structural characterization.
